title: Find Proteins of Unknown Function (PUFs) using Plantannot - Protocol F
author: Marcos Viana
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bgdkjs4w

steps.title: Open Plantannot Find page
steps.instruction: Navigate to https://www.machado.cnptia.embrapa.br/plantannot/find/?q= (or open https://www.machado.cnptia.embrapa.br/plantannot and click the empty search magnifying glass) so that the page loads with all filters empty.

steps.title: Select Organism filter
steps.instruction: In the left‑hand “Organisms” filter, expand the list using the green arrow, choose the desired organism (e.g., Oropetium thomaeum) or leave all boxes unchecked to include all organisms, then click “apply”. The page reloads with URL …selected_facets=organism%3AOropetium+thomaeum.

steps.title: Set Feature type to polypeptide
steps.instruction: In the “Feature type” filter choose “polypeptide” and click “apply”. The URL updates with …selected_facets=so_term%3Apolypeptide.

steps.title: Enable Orthology filter
steps.instruction: In the “Orthology” filter select “orthology” and click “apply”. The URL now contains …orthology%3A1.

steps.title: Enable Co‑expression filter
steps.instruction: In the “Orthologs_coexpression” filter select “co‑expression” and click “apply”. The URL now contains …orthologs_coexpression%3Atrue.

steps.title: Search for Unknown function
steps.instruction: Enter the text “Unknown function” in the top search box and click the magnifying‑glass icon to run the query. The URL now includes q=Unknown+function and the analyses facets for diamond matches and no interproscan matches.

substeps.instruction: Type “Unknown function” in the search box.

steps.title: Confirm applied filters
steps.instruction: Verify that the address bar matches https://www.machado.cnptia.embrapa.br/plantannot/find/?q=Unknown+function&selected_facets=organism%3AOropetium+thomaeum&selected_facets=so_term%3Apolypeptide&selected_facets=orthology%3A1&selected_facets=orthologs_coexpression%3Atrue&selected_facets=analyses%3Adiamond+matches&selected_facets=analyses%3Ano+interproscan+matches.

steps.title: View PUF results
steps.instruction: Look at the “Results” card at the centre‑right of the screen; the list shows Oropetium’s proteins of unknown function (4 PUFs were returned).
